entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party
 Mr. Manoj Kumar Mohanty, Additional Standing Counsel
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.
3.

The Petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Nayagarh P.S. Case No.88 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.363 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Nayagarh for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 294/341/354/506/420/406 of IPC.
4. The prosecution case is that the Petitioner took false signature to transfer the ownership of bus and also abused the informant in obscene language.

5. Considering the above fact and the nature of accusations and also the materials on record, while not being inclined to grant anticipatory bail, the ABLAPL is disposed of granting liberty to the Petitioner to surrender before the Court below within a week from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, he shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the Court below may deem fit and proper to impose.
